name: variant_c
label: Variant: line L to RER C south, RER C west to line H
about: No tunnel from Nord-Est to Saint-Lazare. Line L runs to Châtelet-Les Halles and Austerlitz and on as RER C to the south; RER C from the west runs from Saint-Michel to Châtelet-Les Halles and Nord-Est and on as line H. RER G, the TER, line K into RER B and line R into RER D as in the other version.
